name: Sin And The Bible
overview: The Bible reveals that sin brings spiritual death, as emphasized in Ezekiel where each soul is responsible for its own sin and faces its consequences. Yet, God's power to save remains unfailing, inviting sinners to seek Him while He is near. Christ extends a gracious invitation to all who thirst for forgiveness to come to Him, and through repentance and baptism in Jesus' name, believers receive the remission of sins and the gift of the Holy Spirit.
